title: Live SVG graph plotter for lab readings (ticks, units, best-fit, slope triangle, intercepts, theory curves, live marker)

x.doc: { label, unit, min, max, step?, decimals? }

y.doc: { label, unit, min, max, step?, decimals? }

series.doc: [{ id, name, tone, points:[[x,y]], fit:'line'|'origin', extend, join, fn, fnRange, dashed, slope:{dx,dy,name,unit,abs}, yIntercept, xIntercept, note, shape:'square' }]

events.point: { x, y, series } when a plotted point is tapped

files.style: kit.css (also inlined in the lesson shell's style.css)
